w1-c01.program:
app "Tailoring orders" pen plum
table order customer text, suit pick Shalwar_kameez|Three_piece|Waistcoat|Sherwani|Other, fabric text? "Fabric colour", note long?, due date, price money, advance money = 0, delivered bool
let owed = sum(order where delivered = no, it.price - it.advance)
stat owed, "still owed to me"
"Due this week:" count(order where delivered = no and due >= today and due <= today + 7) faint
form order, "Add order"
"Who still owes me" head
each order where delivered = no and price > advance sort due
  row card tap edit it
    stack grow gap 0
      it.customer bold
      it.suit it.fabric faint
      "Due" it.due faint
    it.price - it.advance bold color bad
    toggle it.delivered
list order

w1-c02.program:
app "Solar log" sun ocean
table output day date = today, kwh num 0.. unit "kWh", weather pick Sunny|Cloudy|Rainy
let mon = today - monthday(today) + 1
let wk = today - weekday(today) + 1
stat max(output.kwh), "best day so far (kWh)"
"This month" sum(output.kwh where day >= mon) "kWh" faint
form output, "Add today's output"
"Last 14 days" head
daybars last 14 days, sum(output.kwh where day = it)
"kWh per week, last 8 weeks" head
bars 1..8, sum(output.kwh where day >= wk - 7 * (8 - it) and day < wk - 7 * (7 - it)), join("W", it)
list output

remind "Water change day" at 9:00 on sun
row gap 3

      t bold

w1-c04.program:
app "Udhaar book" book mint
table entry customer text, kind pick Took|Paid_back, amount money "Amount (Rs)", day date = today
state q text
let pending = sum(entry where kind = Took, it.amount) - sum(entry where kind = Paid_back, it.amount)
stat pending, "total pending (Rs)"
form entry, "Add entry"
field q "Find someone by name"
"Who owes" head
each entry where has(customer, q) by customer
  row card
    it.key bold grow
    sum(it, if(it.kind = Took, it.amount, 0 - it.amount)) bold
list entry where has(customer, q) by day

w1-c05.program:
app "Dialysis log" heart ocean
table session day date = today, start time, hours num 0.5..12 unit "h", before num 20..200 unit "kg" "Weight before", after num 20..200 unit "kg" "Weight after"
stat last(session.before) - last(session.after), "fluid removed last session (kg)"
form session, "Add session"
"Weight after each session" head
trend session, it.after
each session as s empty "No sessions yet"
  row card tap edit s swipe remove s
    stack grow gap 0
      s.day bold
      "Start" s.start "for" s.hours "h" faint
    "removed" fixed(s.before - s.after, 1) "kg" bold

w1-c06.program:
app "Egg count" egg mint
table eggs day date = today, n num 0.. "Eggs collected", cracked num 0.. = 0
setting hens num 1.. = 12 "Hens"
setting price money = 40 "Price per egg (Rs)"
let mon = today - weekday(today) + 1
let wk = sum(eggs.n where day >= mon)
row gap 3
  stat wk, "eggs this week"
  stat fixed(wk / (hens * 7), 2), "per hen per day"
stat sum(eggs where day >= mon, (it.n - it.cracked) * price), "income this week (Rs)"
form eggs, "Add day"
"Eggs per day" head
daybars last 14 days, sum(eggs.n where day = it)
remind "Enter today's eggs" at 20:00
list eggs by day

w1-c07.program:

w1-c09.program:
app "Zakat" coin mint
state gold num = 0
state gold_rate money = 0
state silver num = 0
state silver_rate money = 0
state cash money = 0
let total = gold * gold_rate + silver * silver_rate + cash
let nisab = 52.5 * silver_rate
stack card gap 2
  field gold "Gold (tola)"
  field gold_rate "Gold rate per tola"
  field silver "Silver (tola)"
  field silver_rate "Silver rate per tola"
  field cash "Cash at home and savings"
"Total wealth" total head
stat total * 0.025, "zakat due (2.5 percent)"
row gap 3
  stat gold * gold_rate * 0.025, "gold zakat"
  stat silver * silver_rate * 0.025, "silver zakat"
  stat cash * 0.025, "cash zakat"
if silver_rate > 0
  if total >= nisab
    "Above nisab (52.5 tola silver = " nisab "): zakat is due" color good
  else
    "Below nisab (" nisab "): no zakat due" color warn

w1-k10.program:
app "Meeting time" clock ocean
state city pick Islamabad|London|New_York = Islamabad
state t time = 9:00
state bst bool = no
state edt bool = no
let off_src = if(city = Islamabad, 5, if(city = London, if(bst, 1, 0), if(edt, -4, -5)))
let utc = hour(t) - off_src
let shift_ldn = utc + if(bst, 1, 0)
let shift_ny = utc + if(edt, -4, -5)
let shift_isb = utc + 5
let m = if(minute(t) < 10, join("0", minute(t)), join(minute(t)))
"Time is in" faint
choice city
field t "Time"
toggle bst
"London on summer time" faint
toggle edt
"New York on summer time" faint
def zone name text, h num
  row card
    text name bold grow
    text join(h % 24, ":", m) big
    text if(floor(h / 24) > 0, "next day", if(floor(h / 24) < 0, "previous day", "")) faint
zone "Islamabad", shift_isb
zone "London", shift_ldn
zone "New York", shift_ny

w1-r01.program:
app "Plank intervals" timer ocean
state round num = 1
state resting bool = no
state going bool = no
state ends when = now
setting work dur = 40s "Hold"
setting rest dur = 20s "Rest"
when going and now >= ends and round >= 6 and not resting set going = no then notify "All 6 rounds done"
when going and now >= ends and not resting and round < 6 set resting = yes then set ends = now + rest
when going and now >= ends and resting set resting = no then set round = round + 1 then set ends = now + work
"Round" round "of 6" head
text if(going, if(resting, "Rest", "Hold"), "Ready") big color if(resting, good, accent)
text if(going, max(ends - now, 0s), work) big
row gap 1
  button "Start" tap set round = 1 then set resting = no then set ends = now + work then set going = yes
  button "Stop" tap set going = no

w1-r03.program:
app "Tasbeeh" beads mint
table zikr
state n num = 0
state target num = 33
when n > 0 and n = target notify "Target reached"
row gap 1
  button "33" fill if(target = 33, accent, soft) tap set target = 33
  button "99" fill if(target = 99, accent, soft) tap set target = 99
  button "100" fill if(target = 100, accent, soft) tap set target = 100
draw width 240 tap set n = n + 1 then add zikr
  circle 44 stroke soft thick 8
  arc 44, 0, 360 * min(n, target) / target stroke if(n >= target, good, accent) thick 8
  label 50, 50, n big
if n >= target
  "Target of" target "reached" head color good
button "Reset" tap set n = 0
"Total count ever" count(zikr) faint

w1-r06.program:
app "Chess clock" board ink
state a dur = 10m
state b dur = 10m
state turn num = 0
every 1s if turn = 1 and a > 0s set a = a - 1s
every 1s if turn = 2 and b > 0s set b = b - 1s
when a <= 0s and turn = 1 set turn = 0
when b <= 0s and turn = 2 set turn = 0
"Tap your side after your move" faint align center
box card fill if(turn = 2, accent, soft) height 160 tap set turn = 1
  text a huge align center
  text if(a <= 0s, "Player 1 lost on time", "Player 1") align center
box card fill if(turn = 1, accent, soft) height 160 tap set turn = 2
  text b huge align center
  text if(b <= 0s, "Player 2 lost on time", "Player 2") align center
button "Reset" tap set a = 10m then set b = 10m then set turn = 0

w1-r07.program:
app "Screen time" phone ocean
table use kid pick Kid_1|Kid_2, spent dur
state cur pick Nobody|Kid_1|Kid_2 = Nobody
state st when = now
setting allowance dur = 90m "Daily allowance"
let left(sp dur, on bool) = max(allowance - sp - if(on, now - st, 0s), 0s) / 1m
def kidrow name text, mins num, on bool, go act, stop act
  stack card gap 1
    row gap 2 align center
      text name bold grow
      text mins big
      text "min left" faint
    if on
      button "Stop" tap stop
    else
      button "Start" tap go
kidrow "Kid 1", left(sum(use.spent today where kid = Kid_1), cur = Kid_1), cur = Kid_1, set st = now then set cur = Kid_1, add use kid = Kid_1, spent = now - st then set cur = Nobody
kidrow "Kid 2", left(sum(use.spent today where kid = Kid_2), cur = Kid_2), cur = Kid_2, set st = now then set cur = Kid_2, add use kid = Kid_2, spent = now - st then set cur = Nobody

w1-r09.program:

let off = if(full(today), 0, 1)

w1-r10.program:
app "Pomodoro" timer ink
state phase pick Work|Break|Long = Work
state round num = 1
state held dur = 25m
state ends when = now
state going bool = no
when going and phase = Work and round < 4 and now >= ends set phase = Break then set ends = now + 5m then notify "Break time"
when going and phase = Work and round >= 4 and now >= ends set phase = Long then set ends = now + 15m then notify "Long break"
when going and phase = Break and now >= ends set phase = Work then set round = round + 1 then set ends = now + 25m then notify "Back to work"
when going and phase = Long and now >= ends set phase = Work then set round = 1 then set ends = now + 25m then notify "New cycle"
"Round" round "of 4" head align center
text phase color if(phase = Work, accent, good) align center
text if(going, max(ends - now, 0s), held) huge align center
row gap 1
  if going
    button "Pause" tap set held = ends - now then set going = no
  else
    button "Start" tap set ends = now + held then set going = yes
  button "Reset" tap set going = no then set phase = Work then set round = 1 then set held = 25m

w1-r13.program:
app "Dhikr counters" beads mint
table zikr phrase pick Subhanallah|Alhamdulillah|Allahu_Akbar|La_ilaha_illallah|Astaghfirullah
setting target num = 33 "Target for each"
each options zikr.phrase as p
  row card gap 2 align center tap add zikr phrase = p
    text p bold grow
    text count(zikr where phrase = p) big color if(count(zikr where phrase = p) >= target, good, ink)
    button "+1" tap add zikr phrase = p
button "Reset all" tap remove all zikr

w1-r14.program:
app "Stretch routine" walk mint
state idx num = 0
state going bool = no
state ends when = now
let cur = if(idx = 0, "Neck roll", if(idx = 1, "Shoulder circles", if(idx = 2, "Chest opener", if(idx = 3, "Triceps stretch", if(idx = 4, "Side bend", if(idx = 5, "Hamstring reach", if(idx = 6, "Quad stretch", "Calf stretch")))))))
when going and now >= ends and idx < 7 set idx = idx + 1 then set ends = now + 30s
when going and now >= ends and idx >= 7 set going = no then set idx = 0 then notify "Stretch routine done"
text cur head align center
text if(going, max(ends - now, 0s), 30s) huge align center
goal idx + if(going, 1, 0), 8, "stretches", ""
row gap 1
  button "Start" tap set idx = 0 then set ends = now + 30s then set going = yes
  button "Stop" tap set going = no
each ["Neck roll", "Shoulder circles", "Chest opener", "Triceps stretch", "Side bend", "Hamstring reach", "Quad stretch", "Calf stretch"]
  row fill if(going and index = idx, accent, soft) pad 1
    text index + 1 bold
    text it grow

w1-r15.program:
app "Speech timer" clock ocean
state mins num = 5
state held dur
state paused bool = no
state ends when = now
state going bool = no
let left = if(going, max(ends - now, 0s), if(paused, held, 1m * mins))
when going and now >= ends set going = no then set paused = no then notify "Time is up"
field mins "Minutes"
box card pad 3 fill if(left <= 0s, bad, if(left <= 60s, warn, good))
  text left huge align center
row gap 1
  if going
    button "Pause" tap set held = ends - now then set paused = yes then set going = no
  else
    button "Start" tap set ends = now + if(paused, held, 1m * mins) then set going = yes
  button "Reset" tap set going = no then set paused = no

w1-t03.program:
app "Qaza namaz" mosque mint
table prayed prayer pick Fajr|Zuhr|Asr|Maghrib|Isha|Witr
setting fajr num 0.. = 1200 "Fajr missed"
setting zuhr num 0.. = 900 "Zuhr missed"
setting asr num 0.. = 1000 "Asr missed"
setting maghrib num 0.. = 800 "Maghrib missed"
setting isha num 0.. = 700 "Isha missed"
setting witr num 0.. = 300 "Witr missed"
let total = fajr + zuhr + asr + maghrib + isha + witr - count(prayed)
stat total, "qaza prayers remaining"
def qrow name text, left num, go act
  row card gap 2 align center
    text name bold grow
    text left big
    button "-1" tap go
qrow "Fajr", fajr - count(prayed where prayer = Fajr), add prayed prayer = Fajr
qrow "Zuhr", zuhr - count(prayed where prayer = Zuhr), add prayed prayer = Zuhr
qrow "Asr", asr - count(prayed where prayer = Asr), add prayed prayer = Asr
qrow "Maghrib", maghrib - count(prayed where prayer = Maghrib), add prayed prayer = Maghrib
qrow "Isha", isha - count(prayed where prayer = Isha), add prayed prayer = Isha
qrow "Witr", witr - count(prayed where prayer = Witr), add prayed prayer = Witr
"Prayed today" count(prayed today) faint

w1-t30.program:
app "Kabari" scale slate
table purchase item pick Iron|Paper|Plastic|Copper, kg num 0.., rate money "Rate per kg", seller text?
table sale item pick Iron|Paper|Plastic|Copper, kg num 0.., rate money "Sale rate per kg"
let spent = sum(purchase, it.kg * it.rate)
let sold = sum(sale, it.kg * it.rate)
row gap 3
  stat spent, "total spent"
  stat sold, "total sales"
form purchase, "Add purchase"
each purchase as p empty "No purchases yet"
  row card tap edit p swipe remove p
    stack grow gap 0
      p.item p.kg "kg" bold
      p.seller faint
    p.kg * p.rate bold
"Selling later" head
form sale, "Add sale"
each options purchase.item as o
  row card
    o bold grow
    "profit" sum(sale where item = o, it.kg * it.rate) - sum(sale where item = o, it.kg) * sum(purchase where item = o, it.kg * it.rate) / max(sum(purchase.kg where item = o), 1) bold
